properties.areaDesc: Southern Trinity; Northwestern Interior Mendocino; Northeastern Interior Mendocino; Northern Lake
properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 18 at 5:56PM PDT until October 19 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 34 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Northern Mendocino Interior, Southern Trinity, and Northern
Lake.

* WHEN...From 2 AM to 9 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Localized areas may see temperatures more
briefly drop to 31
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

NWSheadline: FROST ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 2 AM TO 9 AM PDT MONDAY

properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 18 at 12:43PM PDT until October 20 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves. Surf of 3 to 6
feet with local sets to 7 feet, primarily for south-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas. Highest waves on south and southwest facing
beaches.

* WHEN...Now through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across south-facing
beaches.
properties.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY MORNING

properties.areaDesc: Ventura County Beaches; Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 18 at 12:31PM PDT until October 20 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to elevated
surf of 3 to 6 feet expected.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles
County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion and tidal overflows
may occur across south-facing beaches especially in the Long
Beach area.
properties.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY MORNING

properties.areaDesc: San Francisco; Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National Seashore; San Francisco Peninsula Coast; Northern Monterey Bay; Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 17 at 6:02AM PDT until October 18 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...An increased risk for sneaker waves and strong rip
currents with breaking waves of 7 to 12 ft.

* WHERE...Pacific Coast beaches.

* WHEN...3 AM Saturday through 9 PM Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning,
pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks.
properties.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH SUNDAY EVENING
